scope: Ground-state periodic HF/DFT/hybrid capabilities of CRYSTAL23 (User's Manual section 1.2 'CRYSTAL23 Program Features'; Erba et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 19, 6891 (2023), DOI 10.1021/acs.jctc.2c00958) against vibe-qc main, for the #593 parity programme. Operational evidence stays in the tracker and in private evidence stores.

states.implemented: A public route exists and runs; no focused repository test or reference comparison is claimed for this row.
states.source-tested: Implemented and covered by focused repository tests of source functionality, refusals or internal identities; no matched external numerical reference.
states.numerically-accepted: A matched reference comparison passed on a recorded source/native runtime within a stated tolerance, for the bounded scope named in the evidence; not whole-method parity.
states.unverified: Implemented, but an open numerical defect, a failed or contradictory comparison, or a missing reference comparison is on record.
states.unsupported: Absent or explicitly refused; a precise refusal is an acceptable release boundary, not a parity claim.
